description.en: CBX-Bench is a benchmark for quantitatively measuring the quality of Concept Bottleneck Model (CBM) explanations. It uses a council of five open-weight multimodal LLMs to score explanations given an image and class, validated against human preferences. The benchmark maintains a leaderboard for CBM explanation quality.

evidence.snippet: Building on this validated council, we introduce CBX-Bench, a public benchmark and leaderboard: authors of new CBMs can submit their model's explanations, and CBX-Bench scores them with the council and maintains dataset-level rankings of explanation quality.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: CBM interpretability is often evaluated by downstream accuracy, lacking quantitative measures of explanation quality. CBX-Bench offers a human-aligned, scalable evaluation that does not require concept ground truth, enabling comparison of explanation quality across different CBMs.
